pairs.target: dìsāntiān xiàwǔ méiyǒu kè .
pairs.english: There were no lessons on the third afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 第三天下午没有课。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi huí qǐn fáng zhǎo liàngzhe de wàzi , fāxiàn yán dài de zhǔrén zhèng guì zài chuángshàng , bǎ yìtuán bù wǎng xiùzǐ lǐ sāi .
pairs.english: Tavi went back to the dorm room for his drying socks and found the salt bag's owner kneeling on his bed, stuffing a bundle of cloth into his sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回寝房找晾着的袜子，发现盐袋的主人正跪在床上，把一团布往袖子里塞。

pairs.target: " bāng wǒ dǎng yíxià mén . " nà shàonián shuō .
pairs.english: “Block the door for me,” the boy said.
pairs.hanzi: “帮我挡一下门。”那少年说。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn dào ménbiān , yòu juéde bú duì : " nǐ ná le shuí de dōngxī ? "
pairs.english: Tavi stood by the door, then had second thoughts. “Whose things did you take?”
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站到门边，又觉得不对：“你拿了谁的东西？”

pairs.target: shàonián bǎ bù tuán chōuchūlái . wàimiàn chán zhe máxiàn , zhōngjiān gǔgǔde , shì gèjiù bù qiú .
pairs.english: The boy pulled out the bundle. Wound with hemp thread and bulging in the middle, it was an old cloth ball.
pairs.hanzi: 少年把布团抽出来。外面缠着麻线，中间鼓鼓的，是个旧布球。

pairs.target: " wǒ de . pà wò . wǒ shìbushì hái méi gàosù nǐ míngzì ? "
pairs.english: “Mine. Pavo. Haven't I told you my name yet?”
pairs.hanzi: “我的。帕沃。我是不是还没告诉你名字？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō méiyǒu . pà wò diǎndiǎntóu , fǎngfú zhèjiàn shì xiànzài jiùsuàn bàntuǒ le , bào zhe qiú tiào xià chuáng .
pairs.english: Tavi said no. Pavo nodded as if that matter was now settled, and jumped off the bed holding the ball.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说没有。帕沃点点头，仿佛这件事现在就算办妥了，抱着球跳下床。

pairs.target: dōng yuàn hòumiàn yǒu kuài jiù shàichǎng , sānmiàn shì ǎiqiáng , dìshàng liú zhe chāidiào mùjià hòu de shíkǒng .
pairs.english: Behind the east courtyard was an old drying yard, with low walls on three sides and holes in the stone floor where wooden racks had been removed.
pairs.hanzi: 东院后面有块旧晒场，三面是矮墙，地上留着拆掉木架后的石孔。

pairs.target: wǔhòu de yǐngzi héngguò bànpiàn chǎngdì .
pairs.english: Afternoon shadows stretched across half the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 午后的影子横过半片场地。

pairs.target: yīwén yǐjīng zài nàlǐ , zhèng ná fěnbǐhuà liǎngtiáoxiàn ; mǐlā dūn zài lìngyìtóu , yòng xiédǐ mópíng yìxiǎokuài tūqǐ de ní .
pairs.english: Iven was already there, drawing two lines with chalk; Mira crouched at the other end, smoothing a small lump of dirt with her sole.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文已经在那里，正拿粉笔画两条线；米拉蹲在另一头，用鞋底磨平一小块凸起的泥。

pairs.target: " tā cóng xīyuàn yílù wèn guòlái de , " tā zhǐzhǐ pà wò , " wèn shuí huì tīmén xiàn . wǒ shuō búhuì . "
pairs.english: “He asked all the way from the west courtyard,” she said, pointing to Pavo. “Who knew goal-line ball. I said I didn't.”
pairs.hanzi: “他从西院一路问过来的，”她指指帕沃，“问谁会踢门线。我说不会。”

pairs.target: " búhuì cái hǎo , " pà wò shuō , " yīwén huì . "
pairs.english: “All the better,” Pavo said. “Iven knows.”
pairs.hanzi: “不会才好，”帕沃说，“伊文会。”

pairs.target: sìgè rén fēnchéng liǎngbiān , tǎ wéi gēn mǐlā .
pairs.english: They split into two teams, Tavi with Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 四个人分成两边，塔维跟米拉。

pairs.target: guīzé bìng bùnán : qiú tiē dì tī , guò duìmiàn de xiàn suàn yìfēn , chū biān jiù jiāogěi lìngyìbiān , cóng chūjiè de dìfāng tīhuílái .
pairs.english: The rules were simple: kick along the ground, score a point past the other team's line, and if it went out, give it to the other team to kick back in from that spot.
pairs.hanzi: 规则并不难：球贴地踢，过对面的线算一分，出边就交给另一边，从出界的地方踢回来。

pairs.target: bùxǔ yòng shǒu , yě bùxǔ tuī rén .
pairs.english: No hands, and no pushing.
pairs.hanzi: 不许用手，也不许推人。

pairs.target: liǎngtiáo mén xiàn gè yǒu sānbù kuān , xiàn hòu shì ǎiqiáng , búpà qiú gǔn yuǎn .
pairs.english: Each goal line was three paces wide; low walls behind them kept the ball from rolling far.
pairs.hanzi: 两条门线各有三步宽，线后是矮墙，不怕球滚远。

pairs.target: pà wò bǎ qiú gē zài zhōngjiān , tèyì yòng jiǎojiān yā le yā . " xiān dào wǔfēn . "
pairs.english: Pavo set the ball in the middle and deliberately pressed it with his toe. “First to five.”
pairs.hanzi:
帕沃把球搁在中间，特意用脚尖压了压。
“先到五分。”

pairs.target: dìyī jiǎo jiù chū le biān . búshì tǎ wéi tī de .
pairs.english: The very first kick went out. It wasn't Tavi's.
pairs.hanzi:
第一脚就出了边。
不是塔维踢的。

pairs.target: mǐlā yònglì tài dà , qiú cā zhe yīwén de xié guòqù , jìngzhí zhuàng shàng le shuǐcáo .
pairs.english: Mira used too much force; the ball skimmed Iven's shoe and went straight into the trough.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉用力太大，球擦着伊文的鞋过去，径直撞上了水槽。

pairs.target: pà wò xiào dé wān xiàyāo , yīwén qù jiǎnqiú , huílái shí yǐjīng yìbiān zǒu yìbiān jiǎng zěnyàng yòng jiǎo nèicè kòng fāngxiàng .
pairs.english: Pavo doubled over laughing. Iven fetched the ball and was already explaining how to aim with the inside of the foot as he walked back.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃笑得弯下腰，伊文去捡球，回来时已经一边走一边讲怎样用脚内侧控方向。

pairs.target: mǐlā dīng zhe tā de xié . " nǐ xiān tī . "
pairs.english: Mira stared at his shoes. “You kick first.”
pairs.hanzi:
米拉盯着他的鞋。
“你先踢。”

pairs.target: yīwén guǒrán tī dé zhǔn . qiú cóng tǎ wéi jiǎo biān liūguòqù , pà wò yíngshànglái , qīngqīng yì bō , jiù guò le mén xiàn .
pairs.english: Iven did kick accurately. The ball slipped past Tavi's feet; Pavo came to meet it, and one gentle tap sent it over the goal line.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文果然踢得准。球从塔维脚边溜过去，帕沃迎上来，轻轻一拨，就过了门线。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái shǒu zài yuándì , xiàng yìgēn méi láidejí bá de mùzhuāng .
pairs.english: Tavi was still guarding the same spot, like a wooden stake nobody had pulled up in time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维还守在原地，像一根没来得及拔的木桩。

pairs.target: " nǐ dé dòng . " mǐlā shuō . " wǒ gāngcái zài děng tā . " " bié děng le , tā yǐjīng jìnqù le . "
pairs.english: “You have to move,” Mira said. “I was waiting for him.” “Stop waiting. He's already scored.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你得动。”米拉说。
“我刚才在等他。”
“别等了，他已经进去了。”

pairs.target: lún dào tāmen kāiqiú , tǎ wéi shì zhe wǎng mǐlā shēn qián tī .
pairs.english: On their turn to start, Tavi tried kicking it ahead of Mira.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到他们开球，塔维试着往米拉身前踢。

pairs.target: qiú hěn qīng , bǐ bānyùn chǎngshàng nàxiē sāi le shāzi de bùbāo qīng dé duō , tā yì shōu lì , fǎnér méi sòngdào .
pairs.english: The ball was light, much lighter than the sand-filled cloth sacks at the loading yard; he held back and didn't send it far enough.
pairs.hanzi: 球很轻，比搬运场上那些塞了沙子的布包轻得多，他一收力，反而没送到。

pairs.target: yīwén shēnjiǎo jié zǒu , zuǐlǐ hái zài shuō : " nǐ zhèyàng ——"
pairs.english: Iven stuck out a foot to intercept, still saying, “You should—”
pairs.hanzi: 伊文伸脚截走，嘴里还在说：“你这样——”

pairs.target: qiú pèngdào shíkǒng biān , hūrán tiào le yíxià , cóng tā liǎng tuǐ jiān chuān guòqù .
pairs.english: The ball hit the edge of a stone hole, suddenly hopped, and went between his legs.
pairs.hanzi: 球碰到石孔边，忽然跳了一下，从他两腿间穿过去。

pairs.target: zhèhuí lún dào mǐlā xiào le . tā xiào zhe zhuī shàng qiú , méi tíng wěn jiù tī , yòu piān le .
pairs.english: This time Mira laughed. She caught up laughing and kicked before steadying herself, missing again.
pairs.hanzi: 这回轮到米拉笑了。她笑着追上球，没停稳就踢，又偏了。

pairs.target: shài chǎngbiān de qiángshàng jiànjiàn zuò le jǐgè rén .
pairs.english: A few people gradually gathered on the wall beside the yard.
pairs.hanzi: 晒场边的墙上渐渐坐了几个人。

pairs.target: yǒu gè xuéshēng kěnzhe lí , tì tāmen shùfēn , shù dào sān bǐ èr shí , shuí yě bú jìde nǎbiān shì sān .
pairs.english: A student eating a pear kept score for them, but at three to two nobody remembered which team had three.
pairs.hanzi: 有个学生啃着梨，替他们数分，数到三比二时，谁也不记得哪边是三。

pairs.target: pà wò shuōchuān shēn yīfu de , yīwén dītóu kànkàn zìjǐ , yòu kànkàn tǎ wéi , shēnshǒu bǎ lǐngkǒu chěkāi .
pairs.english: Pavo said the ones in dark clothes. Iven looked down at himself, then at Tavi, and pulled open his collar.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说穿深衣服的，伊文低头看看自己，又看看塔维，伸手把领口扯开。

pairs.target: " xiànzài wǒ lù zhe bózi , suàn jìhào . "
pairs.english: “Now my neck's showing. That's our marker.”
pairs.hanzi: “现在我露着脖子，算记号。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tuō xià wàiyī , dā zài qiángtóu .
pairs.english: Tavi took off his jacket and draped it over the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维脱下外衣，搭在墙头。

pairs.target: shàichǎng de ní dì bùpíng , tā búzài dītóu zhuī zhe qiú pǎo , érshì liú yìdiǎn jùlí , kàn lìngwài liǎnggè rén de jiǎo .
pairs.english: The yard's dirt floor was uneven. He stopped running after the ball with his head down and left some distance instead, watching the other two players' feet.
pairs.hanzi: 晒场的泥地不平，他不再低头追着球跑，而是留一点距离，看另外两个人的脚。

pairs.target: pà wò xiǎng cóng tā zuǒbiān rào , tā xiān tuì le yíbù , bǎ nàtiáo lù dǔzhù .
pairs.english: Pavo tried circling to his left; Tavi took a step back and blocked the way.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃想从他左边绕，他先退了一步，把那条路堵住。

pairs.target: qiú zhuàng shàng tā de xié , tíng le . mǐlā zài yòubiān jiào tā , tā láibùjí xiǎng , jiǎo yǐjīng bǎ qiú sòng guòqù .
pairs.english: The ball hit his shoe and stopped. Mira called from the right; before he could think, his foot had already sent it to her.
pairs.hanzi: 球撞上他的鞋，停了。米拉在右边叫他，他来不及想，脚已经把球送过去。

pairs.target: tā zhècì méiyǒu shǐjìn , qiú mànmàn gǔn guò xiàn .
pairs.english: This time she used little force; the ball rolled slowly across the line.
pairs.hanzi: 她这次没有使劲，球慢慢滚过线。

pairs.target: qiángshàng de rén dōu kànjiàn le , piānpiān méi rén hǎn . guò le yíhuìer , chī lí de cái shuō : " zhège suàn . "
pairs.english: Everyone on the wall saw it, yet nobody called out. After a moment the pear-eater said, “That counts.”
pairs.hanzi: 墙上的人都看见了，偏偏没人喊。过了一会儿，吃梨的才说：“这个算。”

pairs.target: " dāngrán suàn ! " mǐlā shuō .
pairs.english: “Of course it counts!” Mira said.
pairs.hanzi: “当然算！”米拉说。

pairs.target: hòulái bǐfēn yòu luàn le yícì .
pairs.english: Later they lost track of the score again.
pairs.hanzi: 后来比分又乱了一次。

pairs.target: tàiyáng yí dào qiángjiǎo shí , sìgè rén dōu shuō zìjǐ zhè yìbiān yǒu sìfēn , yúshì yuē hǎo , shuí zài jìn yígè shuí yíng .
pairs.english: When the sun reached the corner of the wall, all four claimed their team had four points, so they agreed the next goal would win.
pairs.hanzi: 太阳移到墙角时，四个人都说自己这一边有四分，于是约好，谁再进一个谁赢。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi de é fātiē zài méi shàng , bèixīn shītòu le .
pairs.english: Tavi's fringe clung to his brows, and the back of his shirt was soaked.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维的额发贴在眉上，背心湿透了。

pairs.target: pà wò bǐ kāishǐ shí ānjìng , hūxī hěn xiǎng .
pairs.english: Pavo was quieter than at the start, breathing loudly.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃比开始时安静，呼吸很响。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ qiú hù zài xié biān , jiǎzhuāng wǎng zuǒ kàn , jiǎo què wǎngyòu bō .
pairs.english: Iven shielded the ball by his shoe, pretending to look left while moving his foot right.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把球护在鞋边，假装往左看，脚却往右拨。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnzhe dòng le . qiú méiyǒu zǒu , yīwén yòu bǎ tā lāhuílái .
pairs.english: Tavi moved with him. The ball hadn't gone anywhere; Iven pulled it back.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟着动了。球没有走，伊文又把它拉回来。

pairs.target: tā zài xiǎng zhuǎnshēn , jiǎodǐ yì huá , zuò dào le dìshàng .
pairs.english: When Tavi tried turning again, his foot slipped and he landed sitting on the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 他再想转身，脚底一滑，坐到了地上。

pairs.target: mǐlā pū guòqù lán , pà wò qiǎng zài tā qiánmiàn , bǎ qiú pèng guò xiàn .
pairs.english: Mira lunged to block it, but Pavo beat her to it and knocked the ball over the line.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉扑过去拦，帕沃抢在她前面，把球碰过线。

pairs.target: qiángshàng lìkè yǒurén chuī le shēng kǒushào .
pairs.english: Someone on the wall immediately whistled.
pairs.hanzi: 墙上立刻有人吹了声口哨。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuò zhe méi qǐ , xiān mōmō shǒuzhǎng . zhǐyǒu ní , méiyǒu cāpò .
pairs.english: Tavi stayed sitting and felt his palms first. Just dirt, no grazes.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐着没起，先摸摸手掌。只有泥，没有擦破。

pairs.target: mǐlā shēnshǒu lā tā , tā gāng zhàn qǐlái , jiù tīng tā duì yīwén shuō : " míngtiān . "
pairs.english: Mira pulled him up. He had barely stood when he heard her tell Iven, “Tomorrow.”
pairs.hanzi: 米拉伸手拉他，他刚站起来，就听她对伊文说：“明天。”

pairs.target: " míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu kè . " " hòutiān . "
pairs.english: “We've got lessons tomorrow afternoon.” “The day after.”
pairs.hanzi:
“明天下午有课。”
“后天。”

pairs.target: pà wò bào qǐqiú , wǎng gēbo xià yì jiá , xiàntóu guà zài xiùkòu shàng , chě chū hěn cháng yìgēn .
pairs.english: Pavo tucked the ball under his arm; a loose thread caught on his cuff button and pulled out a long strand.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃抱起球，往胳膊下一夹，线头挂在袖扣上，扯出很长一根。

pairs.target: tā dùnshí bú xiào le , dūnxiàlái , shì zhe bǎ nàgēn xiàn rào huíqù .
pairs.english: His smile vanished. He crouched down and tried winding the thread back.
pairs.hanzi: 他顿时不笑了，蹲下来，试着把那根线绕回去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě dūnxià , niēzhù kuài sànkāi de bù kǒu . " wǒ yǒu zhēn . "
pairs.english: Tavi crouched too, pinching the cloth opening before it came apart. “I've got a needle.”
pairs.hanzi:
塔维也蹲下，捏住快散开的布口。
“我有针。”

pairs.target: pà wò kànzhe tā , xiàng fāxiàn zhè qǐn fáng zhōngyú yǒu le shénme yàojǐn de yòngchu .
pairs.english: Pavo looked at him as if he'd discovered the room finally had some important use.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃看着他，像发现这寝房终于有了什么要紧的用处。

pairs.target: yīwén zuò shàng qiángtóu , cháo chī lí de rén shēnshǒu . nà rén bǎ kěn shèng de lí hé dìguòlái .
pairs.english: Iven sat on the wall and held out a hand to the pear-eater, who passed him the gnawed core.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文坐上墙头，朝吃梨的人伸手。那人把啃剩的梨核递过来。

pairs.target: tā kàn le bàntiān , háishì jiē le , yuǎnyuǎn rēng xiàng qiáng wài de cǎocóng .
pairs.english: He stared a while, then took it anyway and threw it far into the grass beyond the wall.
pairs.hanzi: 他看了半天，还是接了，远远扔向墙外的草丛。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhèngzài chóngxīn miáo nà liǎngtiáo mén xiàn .
pairs.english: Mira was tracing the two goal lines again.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉正在重新描那两条门线。

pairs.target: fěnbǐ kuài yòngjìn le , tā yòng zhǐjiǎjiá zhe zuìhòu yìdiǎn bái , mànmàn bǔ shàng bèi xiédǐ cādiào de quēkǒu .
pairs.english: The chalk was almost gone. She pinched the last white scrap between her nails, slowly filling gaps rubbed away by their soles.
pairs.hanzi: 粉笔快用尽了，她用指甲夹着最后一点白，慢慢补上被鞋底擦掉的缺口。
